"""Load application settings from environment variables."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass, fields
from typing import get_type_hints

PREFIX = "APP_"
TRUE_VALUES = {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}
FALSE_VALUES = {"0", "false", "no", "off"}


class ConfigError(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class AppConfig:
    debug: bool = False
    port: int = 8000
    workers: int = 2
    database_url: str = "sqlite:///app.db"
    request_timeout: float = 10.0
    allowed_hosts: str = "localhost"


def _convert(name: str, raw: str, kind: type) -> object:
    if kind is bool:
        lowered = raw.strip().lower()
        if lowered in TRUE_VALUES:
            return True
        if lowered in FALSE_VALUES:
            return False
        raise ConfigError(f"{name}: expected a boolean, got {raw!r}")
    try:
        return kind(raw)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ConfigError(f"{name}: expected {kind.__name__}, got {raw!r}") from exc


def load_config(environ: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> AppConfig:
    environ = dict(os.environ if environ is None else environ)
    hints = get_type_hints(AppConfig)
    values: dict[str, object] = {}
    for spec in fields(AppConfig):
        key = PREFIX + spec.name.upper()
        if key in environ:
            values[spec.name] = _convert(key, environ[key], hints[spec.name])
    config = AppConfig(**values)
    if config.port <= 0 or config.port > 65535:
        raise ConfigError(f"{PREFIX}PORT out of range: {config.port}")
    if config.workers < 1:
        raise ConfigError(f"{PREFIX}WORKERS must be at least 1")
    return config
